book_title: Chapter 5: The Six Gauges on the Dashboard & Management's Scorecard
question: Which six operational KPIs tell us whether IGIL's compounding engine is accelerating or stalling, and has CEO Tehmasp Printer's team delivered on its promises?

epigraph.quote: Watch the number of stones crossing the microscope and the days it takes to collect the check; those two numbers tell the whole story before the P&L does.
epigraph.author: Service Tollbooth Rule

web_blocks.title: Six leading operational KPIs to track every quarter

web_blocks.html: IGIL's income statement reflects physical throughput, product mix, and credit discipline. Instead of relying solely on headline profit, an owner should track six leading operational KPIs across quarterly filings and presentations.

web_blocks.takeaway: Headline volume (+26% YoY), LGD jewelry (+47% YoY), gemstones (+331% YoY post-AGL), and consolidated margins (61.4%) are expanding strongly, while India standalone margin compression (-340 bps YoY to 69.5%) and debtor days (66 days in FY26) remain active operational watchpoints.

web_blocks.title: Q2 FY27 CONCALL RECORD: VERBATIM CEO & CFO QUOTES (OCT 21, 2026)
paragraphs: Tehmasp Printer (MD & CEO): “This has been the best quarter in IGI's history. Our volumes, our revenue, our EBITDA, and our profits were all the highest we have ever reported.” On brand moat and technology: “It is the IGI certificate that makes the lab-grown diamond a diamond, and it is the same certificate that also protects the value of a natural diamond,” adding that “AI-based work allocation and scheduling is now in use at our laboratories, allowing the same team to grade more stones efficiently.” [4][5]

Eashwar Iyer (Global CFO): “Given the first half performance... with revenues growing 27% and EBITDA growing at 34%... we therefore expect to keep outperforming for the full year as well.” On durability: “There is an element of a first-mover advantage, which IGI has. We were the first to certify lab-grown diamonds. Number two is the fact that there is an element of trust and acceptance for a brand. That has got established over 50 years.” [4][5]

web_blocks.html: The Q2 FY27 numbers show why volume, price, and local margins must be read together. Total reports rose 26% YoY to 4.35 million, while sales grew 31% YoY to ₹398.0 Cr [4]. That five-point spread proves realizations stayed firm near ₹891 per report (+4% YoY consolidated, split evenly between AGL and LGD mix). Gemstones and other grading jumped +331% YoY [4]. Yet headline consolidated margin gains (+340 bps YoY to 61.4%) masked a key split. India standalone EBITDA margin fell 340 bps YoY from 72.8% to 69.5% on ₹305.6 Cr revenue (+27% YoY). Higher leadership, marketing, and commission spend drove that dip, while overseas labs (+31% YoY ex-AGL) lifted consolidated margins.

web_blocks.title: Structural potential and management walk-the-talk audit

web_blocks.html: IGIL's structural runway rests on three clear levers. First, grading rates are rising in studded jewelry, where uncertified local retail still dominates in India. Second, AGL's colored-stone origin reports can scale across IGI's 36-lab network alongside IGI Botswana's September 2026 consolidation. Third, US and Indian bridal buyers keep moving toward larger lab-grown stones. Led by MD and CEO Tehmasp Printer (who founded IGI India in 1999) and Global CFO Eashwar Iyer, management has built a credible post-IPO record.

In the 2024 IPO prospectus, management pledged to fold IGI Belgium and IGI Netherlands into IGIL right after listing and hold ~57%–60% operating margins. Both deals closed on time in December 2024 [7]. ICRA's October 22, 2026 Monitoring Agency Report confirmed zero deviation across ₹1,472.79 Cr of fresh IPO proceeds. In 15M FY26, IGIL posted 61% OPM across 16.45 million reports [6]. Entering FY27, management guided for ~15% sales growth and 20% EBITDA growth. After strong H1 FY27 results (+27% sales and +34% EBITDA YoY), management signaled H2 should match H1—though it declined to issue a formal new numeric target on the Q2 call [4]. Two watchpoints remain: debtor days rising from 47 to 66 days [1] and payback on India standalone SG&A spend.

web_blocks.title: CEO Walk-the-Talk Scorecard: Guidance vs. Execution

web_blocks.html: Under CEO Tehmasp Printer, management has under-promised and over-delivered since the December 2024 listing [4][5]. Entering FY27 amid soft natural-diamond demand, management guided for ~15% sales growth. Actual H1 FY27 execution beat that mark, led by Q2 FY27 sales growth of +31% YoY and 4.35 million reports (+26% YoY). Management later signaled full-year FY27 should handily beat initial guidance and track H1's +27% revenue pace while holding ~58%–60%+ consolidated EBITDA margins [4][5].

Working capital and standalone costs remain the two key operating gauges to watch. Debtor days climbed from 47 days in CY22 to 66 days by March 2026 as jewelry chains sought longer credit. Q2 FY27 then delivered a welcome ₹662M receivables release [4]. Investors should also verify in H2 FY27 that the 340 bps YoY India standalone margin dip (to 69.5%) reflects one-time growth spend rather than rising commission rates.

Promoter Blackstone's 76.55% stake and executive ESOP rules are key governance watchpoints [14]. Under SEBI Rule 19A, newly listed firms must reach 25% public float (maximum 75% promoter stake) within three years of listing. That sets IGIL's deadline at December 2027 [26]. Note 47 of the FY2025-26 Annual Report also discloses 19.55 million active ESOP 2024 options (~4.52% dilution, plus 209,938 options granted May 20, 2026). Sixty percent of that vesting ties directly to Blackstone tranche realization targets. Minority owners must ensure future block-sale optics never weaken fee discipline.

book_paragraphs: Quarterly profit numbers tell you what happened last season; operational gauges tell you what is happening on the factory floor right now. For IGIL, six operational indicators capture the entire business engine. First is total reports issued, which hit 16.45 million during the 15-month FY26 transition period and 4.35 million in Q2 FY27 alone, up 26% YoY. Second is lab-grown diamond volume growth, where LGD jewelry surged 47% and loose LGD rose 37% in Q2 FY27, alongside a 331% YoY jump in gemstones and other certification following the AGL acquisition. Third is implied realization per report—dividing ₹387.5 Cr of Q2 FY27 certification revenue by 4.35 million reports yields roughly ₹891 per report (+4% YoY consolidated), showing that larger carat submissions and AGL mix are more than offsetting wholesale LGD price declines.

Fourth is physical network expansion, now standing at 36 laboratories and 21 gemology schools plus the newly acquired AGL hub in New York and wholly owned IGI Botswana (consolidated September 7, 2026). Fifth is operating EBITDA margin, which climbed 340 basis points YoY to 61.4% on a consolidated basis in Q2 FY27 as overseas subsidiaries turned stronger—even though India standalone EBITDA margin dipped 340 basis points to 69.5% on leadership, marketing, and commission spend. Sixth is debtor days, which drifted from 47 days in 2022 to 66 days in March 2026 before easing in Q2 FY27 via a ₹662 million working-capital release.

book_subsections.title: CEO Walk-the-Talk Audit: Tehmasp Printer and Eashwar Iyer
paragraphs: A management team's credibility is measured by the gap between what it promises during an IPO roadshow and what shows up in audited filings two years later. MD & CEO Tehmasp Printer, who started IGI India in 1999, and CFO Eashwar Iyer promised in December 2024 to consolidate IGI Belgium and IGI Netherlands immediately, defend high-50s operating margins, and compound LGD certification volumes. They delivered on every count: both European acquisitions closed within days of listing (verified clean by ICRA's October 2026 monitoring report), 15M FY26 margins reached 61%, and in October 2026 management indicated H2 FY27 should mirror H1's +27% revenue and +34% EBITDA pace—far ahead of its initial 15%/20% outlook.

Because core volume, AGL gemstone expansion, and overseas leverage are firing cleanly while debtor days and India standalone margin investment (-340 bps YoY to 69.5%) require ongoing vigilance, IGIL earns a PASS_WITH_WATCH on operational KPI health—strong execution backed by real cash, tempered by the need to keep B2B credit terms and domestic commission costs tight.

book_subsections.title: Six Leading KPIs Every Owner Must Track Quarterly
paragraphs: If you own a certification toll-booth, quarterly earnings are a lagging indicator; the real story lives in six operational gauges. First is total reports issued—which just hit 4.35 million in Q2 FY27, up 26% year-on-year. Second is the mix between loose lab-grown solitaires, studded jewelry, natural diamonds, and colored gemstones (+331% YoY post-AGL), because studded jewelry and colored stones carry stickier retail relationships. Third is implied revenue per report (ASP), which tells you instantly whether volume rebates are biting into pricing power.

Fourth is debtor days (DSO): when DSO crept from 47 days to 66 days during the 15-month fiscal transition, skeptics rightly asked if IGI was extending credit to sustain volume; the ₹662 million receivables release in Q2 FY27 was the exact operational proof needed to answer that concern. Fifth is the divergence between consolidated margin (61.4%, +340 bps) and India standalone margin (69.5%, -340 bps on leadership and commission investments), and sixth is integration progress on AGL in colored stones and IGI Botswana. Watch those six dials, and you will spot any inflection—good or bad—two quarters before it hits the headline P&L.

book_subsections.title: The Blackstone Overhang & Management Execution
paragraphs: Every great business has a non-operating variable you must track alongside the P&L. For IGIL, that variable is the shareholder register. Blackstone owns 76.55% of the equity following the December 2024 IPO (unchanged through late November 2026), which puts the company slightly above SEBI's 75% promoter cap under Minimum Public Shareholding rules. Before December 2027, Blackstone must trim at least 1.55%—and as a private equity sponsor, will likely monetize larger blocks along the way.

In the short run, secondary block sales often cap near-term share momentum or trigger air-pockets on announcement day. Over the medium term, however, expanding the free float improves daily liquidity and opens the door for larger domestic mutual fund and passive index inclusions. Judging by CEO Tehmasp Printer's execution—driving +27% H1 revenue growth and +34% EBITDA growth against an initial 15%/20% outlook—the underlying business is outgrowing any private-equity supply overhang.

book_subsections.title: Separating Cyclical Noise from Structural KPIs
paragraphs: In any given quarter, diamond export volumes fluctuate around US holiday restocking, Diwali wedding demand, and Hong Kong jewelry trade shows. If you react to a single slow month of rough imports into Surat, you will miss the multi-year structural trend. Instead, focus on whether IGI's total certified report count is growing faster than global diamond jewelry units—which tells you certification penetration is still rising.

In Q2 FY27, total reports rose 26% year-on-year to 4.35 million while revenue grew 31% to ₹398 crore. That positive spread between revenue growth (+31%) and volume growth (+26%) is the single cleanest operational proof that blended ASPs held firm—driven by higher-value studded jewelry, larger-carat LGD solitaires, and AGL colored stones—rather than being eroded by volume discounting.

book_subsections.title: How Management Incentives Align—and Where Sponsor Vesting Creates Tension
paragraphs: When a private equity sponsor like Blackstone retains 76.55% ownership alongside a professional CEO like Tehmasp Printer, you must read the ESOP footnotes carefully rather than assuming automatic alignment. Note 47 of IGIL's FY2025-26 Annual Report reveals 19.55 million active options under ESOP 2024 (~4.52% potential equity dilution), with 60% of vesting directly tethered to Blackstone sponsor tranche sales or realization thresholds. That design creates a genuine governance tension: senior executives stand to monetize their largest equity grants alongside Blackstone's eventual sell-down, creating an incentive to optimize near-term earnings optics ahead of sponsor block sales.

Encouragingly, operational behavior from FY25 through Q2 FY27 has so far stayed disciplined: consolidated operating margins held at 57% to 61.4%, maintenance capex remained modest, H1 FY27 operating cash flow hit ₹415.7 Cr (89% of EBITDA and 118% of PAT), and Q2 FY27 released ₹662 million of receivables rather than stuffing the channel with loose credit. Even so, minority owners must continue auditing standalone margins and credit quality as the December 2027 MPS compliance window approaches.

book_callouts.title: What This Means for an Owner
book_callouts.text: Volume (+26% YoY), LGD jewelry (+47% YoY), gemstones (+331% YoY post-AGL), and consolidated margins (61.4% OPM) confirm IGIL's core engine is accelerating. Watch three checks closely: debtor days staying below 70, India standalone EBITDA margin stabilizing after its -340 bps dip to 69.5%, and governance discipline around Note 47's sponsor-linked ESOP vesting.
